title: B.L.T. Salad with Basil Mayo Dressing
description: Crispy romaine lettuce, juicy cherry tomatoes, crunchy-fried bacon, and homemade croutons are tossed with a creamy, tangy, fresh basil-infused dressing in this satisfying salad!
ingredients: 4 slices French bread, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
1 pound romaine lettuce - rinsed, dried, and torn into bite-size pieces

steps.text: Place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly brown. Drain, crumble, and set aside, reserving 2 tablespoons of the drippings.
In a small bowl, whisk together the reserved bacon drippings, mayonnaise, vinegar, and basil and let dressing stand, covered, at room temperature.
In a large skillet over medium heat, toss the bread pieces with the salt and pepper. Drizzle with the oil, continue tossing, and cook over medium-low heat until golden brown.
In a large bowl, mix together the romaine, tomatoes, bacon, and croutons. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss well.

video.description: The perfect picnic salad, this big salad combine the crisp, juicy, salty and crunchy notes you crave from an awesome BLT sandwich. The secret, of course, is in the bacon. After you’ve cooked your bacon, reserve drippings, and mix them with mayonnaise, red wine vinegar and basil to create a delicious, creamy dressing. Then cut French bread into pieces, toss with salt and pepper and canola oil, and bake until its turned into crisp, golden brown croutons. Finally, toss the croutons with Romaine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, crumbled bacon and dressing and serve to happy eaters all around.
video.name: BLT Salad with Basil Mayo Dressing
